speaker.name: Efficiency Emilia
speaker.role: Uses deep domain knowledge to define business goals, objectives, and KPIs. Aligns ML features with overarching product strategy and organizational roadmaps. Evaluates system performance, operational capability, and project costs.

output.objection: You are listing the feature store as a pure technical upgrade, but you are ignoring the operational cost I flagged. If we build a complex store that requires a dedicated team to babysit, we are trading one problem for a more expensive one.
output.correction: I am not asking to delete the feature store, I am asking you to price the maintenance burden before we commit to the architecture. If the simpler option saves us the engineering hours, that is the business case I need to see.
